scope: Multiselection on the existing flat SCM resource rows; group/header/mixed-side business parity excluded

cases.contract: Ctrl Windows/Linux or Cmd macOS toggles a resource while retaining other selected resources; pointer selection does not open
cases.boundary: Windows/Linux tests exercise toggle removal from a multiselection; macOS tests exercise addition. Complete native modifier/configuration behavior remains unverified

cases.contract: Shift-click replaces the selected contiguous run at its pointer anchor while retaining disjoint islands; platform toggle+Shift prioritizes range
tests: Shift-click replaces only the anchor run and preserves islands
toggle plus Shift uses range selection on TargetPlatform.windows
toggle plus Shift uses range selection on TargetPlatform.linux
toggle plus Shift uses range selection on TargetPlatform.macOS

cases.contract: Unsupported foreign-platform pointer modifier, including Shift combination, does not alter selection or open
tests: foreign modifier click does not open or select on TargetPlatform.windows
foreign modifier click does not open or select on TargetPlatform.linux
foreign modifier click does not open or select on TargetPlatform.macOS

cases.contract: Windows Ctrl-click acquires SCM keyboard focus when an outside control owned it; subsequent Space calls onOpen for the focused resource with preserveFocus=true
tests: modifier selection moves keyboard focus from an outside control

cases.contract: Shift arrows add destinations or remove previous focused resources when destination is selected; first-row boundary leaves selection unchanged; singleton selection previews with preserveFocus=true
tests: Shift arrows grow, shrink, remove, and stop at boundaries
Shift navigation previews a singleton without taking focus
cases.boundary: Complete tree/group traversal and every navigation modifier are outside these flat-row tests

cases.contract: Local Ctrl+A is scoped to SCM focus, selects offscreen flat resources, leaves focus identity unchanged for singleton, and Enter collapses to the focused resource
tests: select all previews a singleton and keeps focus and anchor
select all is scoped to list focus and Enter collapses selection
cases.boundary: Hierarchical repeated-select-all and group selection are excluded; anchor storage is source-reviewed, not directly exposed by these tests

cases.contract: Refresh prunes removed selected resources, remaps retained staged resources and clears empty-list identities; explicit stage/unstage actions stay single-target under multiselection
tests: refresh prunes multiselection and remaps staged resources
multiselection never batches an explicit row action

cases.contract: Real-workbench modifier selection keeps Git index tree and file bytes unchanged, does not replace the displayed diff, and Space collapses selection before explicit single-file stage
tests: Git changes list opens resources without staging on Space

resources.selectionBound: Current resource count; pruned/remapped on update
resources.rangeRemoval: Linear row-run removal, source-reviewed; no timing benchmark claimed
resources.workspaceReset: Existing workspace-key remount, source-review evidence; no new delayed real-process cancellation test claimed

validation.hostedStatus: CI success; Linux and Windows success; macOS tests/Release/clipboard/launch/package success, native Quit failed, native DnD explicitly skipped
